name: Jamaica
dek: Kingston / Norman Manley, WMO 78397. Precipitation in this file is 27 or 28 years, not 30.
paragraphs: The table is Kingston / Norman Manley, WMO 78397, height 3 m. Precipitation is 27 years in January and 28 years in the other months. October's maximum and May's minimum are 29 years. The other temperature months are 30. Montego Bay / Sangster was not averaged in, and its numbers are not on this page.

The Visit Jamaica FAQ says the water is safe to drink. CDC does not give a yes or a no. The tipping sentence that was opened is about all-inclusive packages, and the sheet says so. The road rule is section 57 of the 2018 Act, which is the left side.

climate.caption: Reference station: Kingston / Norman Manley, WMO 78397. The name in the file. Not Montego Bay.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed. The precipitation number-of-years row prints 27 for January and 28 for the other months. The maximum-temperature row prints 29 for October and 30 otherwise. The minimum-temperature row prints 29 for May and 30 otherwise. Montego Bay / Sangster, WMO 78388, was not averaged with Norman Manley.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Kingston / Norman Manley (78397)

season: The National Hurricane Center says the Atlantic hurricane season runs from 1 June to 30 November.
The same page says the Atlantic basin includes the Caribbean Sea.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 110 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Jamaica at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page on 15 November 2026 did not return the list. The archive is the copy that was read. The frequency on that line is 50 hertz, not 60. This sheet does not change it.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Section 57(1)(a) of the Road Traffic Act, 2018, says that when being approached or overtaken by another vehicle, the driver shall keep the vehicle to the left or near side of the road. Section 57(1)(b) says overtaking is on the right or off-side of the other traffic. The text opened is the Act PDF on the Houses of Parliament site.
driving.sourceTitle: The Road Traffic Act, 2018, section 57, Houses of Parliament

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: The Visit Jamaica general FAQ does not state a tipping practice. A Visit Jamaica page about all-inclusive resorts says every meal, snack, drink order, or bell service already has the tip factored into the package total. This sheet does not turn that sentence into a percent for a restaurant that is not an all-inclusive.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Jamaica, last reviewed 25 August 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice. Separately, the Visit Jamaica FAQ says the water is safe to drink, to clean your teeth, to bathe, and to wash clothing in. This page repeats that sentence and does not add medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Jamaican Dollar and the code JMD for Jamaica. The list's published date, in the Pblshd attribute, is 17 September 2026.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Jamaica one row, America/Jamaica. There is no second Jamaica zone in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The immigration agency's entry and visa requirements. The page prints a last-updated line of 19 July 2023 and a later notice effective 12 October 2026. We do not restate a visa rule.
